headline.en: Inspect an agent trace at the point that matters.
headline.zh: 从关键 Span 检查 Agent 轨迹。

sub.en: ForkSpan loads recorded OTLP GenAI spans into a navigable tree and exports a StateSnapshot at a selected span.
sub.zh: ForkSpan 把记录的 OTLP GenAI Span 加载成可浏览的树，并在选定 Span 导出 StateSnapshot。

body.en: Export the recorded state at an explicit ID.
body.zh: 按明确 ID 导出记录状态。

body.en: TUI navigation and JSON output share the same trace model.
body.zh: TUI 与 JSON 输出使用同一轨迹模型。

body.en: Inspection needs no model call or remote service.
body.zh: 检查无需模型调用或远程服务。

cd forkspan
go build ./cmd/forkspan

limitations.en: fork and replay are not implemented; their current commands print roadmap guidance.
limitations.zh: fork 与 replay 尚未实现，当前命令只输出路线图说明。

limitations.en: Recorded reachability is not proof of causal responsibility. No model or tool is re-executed.
limitations.zh: 记录中的可达性不等于因果责任证明；工具和模型都不会重新执行。

limitations.en: The bundled compromised trace is synthetic and contains no live incident data.
limitations.zh: 随仓异常轨迹是合成数据，不是实时事件记录。

body.en: A suspicious tool call is easier to investigate when its parent spans and reachable downstream calls stay visible. ForkSpan turns a trace export into a local inspection surface with a scriptable snapshot path.
body.zh: 调查可疑工具调用时，需要看到上游 Span 与可达的后续调用。ForkSpan 将轨迹导出文件转成本地检查界面，并提供可脚本化的快照导出。

body.en: ingest parses the OTLP export and builds the span relationships. The TUI renders the tree, and snapshot capture collects the recorded state at the selected ID. The current fork and replay commands are roadmap placeholders; no counterfactual execution is performed.
body.zh: ingest 解析 OTLP 文件并建立 Span 关系；TUI 展示树，快照模块按选定 ID 收集记录状态。当前 fork 和 replay 命令是路线图占位，不执行反事实运行。

body.zh: ingest 解析 OTLP 文件并建立 Span 关系；TUI 展示树，快照模块按选定 ID 收集记录状态。当前 fork 和 replay 命令是路线图占位，不执行反事实运行。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: --list prints the recorded tree without opening a TUI. --snapshot/-s selects a span. --json writes the snapshot to stdout; --out/-o also selects a file destination. In the TUI use j/k to navigate, m to mark, s to save, and q to quit.
body.zh: --list 无需 TUI 即可打印树；--snapshot/-s 选择 Span。--json 将快照写到标准输出，--out/-o 可指定文件。在 TUI 中使用 j/k 移动、m 标记、s 保存、q 退出。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
go run ./cmd/forkspan inspect assets/sample-compromised-trace.json --list
go run ./cmd/forkspan inspect assets/sample-compromised-trace.json -s 0a0b0c0d0e0f0a0b --json
# Interactive navigation requires a terminal:
go run ./cmd/forkspan inspect assets/sample-compromised-trace.json

changelog.en: forkspan v0.8.0: fix version-surface drift — the in-source version var (stuck at v0.6.0 through v0.7.0) and the live-site content_version now stay in lockstep with the VERSION file, and the v0.7.0 release's red CI test suite is green again. `forkspan --version` self-reports the true tag; a new guard test pins site.json to the canonical VERSION so the drift cannot recur. No product-logic change.
changelog.zh: forkspan v0.8.0：修复版本面漂移——源码内版本常量（v0.7.0 发布时仍停在 v0.6.0）与官网 content_version 现与 VERSION 文件保持一致，v0.7.0 发布时变红的 CI 测试套件重新转绿。`forkspan --version` 现正确自报版本；新增守卫测试把 site.json 钉到权威 VERSION，杜绝再次漂移。无产品逻辑变更。

changelog.en: forkspan v0.6.0: orphan spans — whose parent is missing from a partial export (common with partial collector grabs of a compromised-agent run) — no longer vanish from the navigator and `inspect --list`. Tree.Roots() now treats a span with an absent parent as a root, so every span (incl. a pre-marked intrusion span) stays discoverable. Behavior-preserving for well-formed traces.
changelog.zh: forkspan v0.6.0：父 span 缺失的孤儿 span（被攻破 agent 运行的部分导出里常见）不再从导航器和 `inspect --list` 中消失。Tree.Roots() 现在把父 span 不在导出里的 span 也当作根，这样每条 span（含预标记的入侵 span）都能被发现。对结构完整的 trace 行为不变。

changelog.en: forkspan v0.5.0: fix the stale in-source version so the binary self-reports v0.5.0 (was stuck at v0.3.0 through v0.4.0); refresh en+zh-CN README sample output to the real snake_case reached_spans shape; add `inspect --list` to print the recorded span tree non-interactively so CI/scripts can discover span IDs without the TUI.
changelog.zh: forkspan v0.5.0：修正二进制自报版本（v0.4.0 发布时仍打印 v0.3.0）；更新 README 示例输出为真实的 snake_case reached_spans 形状；新增 inspect --list 非交互打印 span 树，便于 CI/脚本发现 span ID。
inspect --snapshot 不再冲突：--json -o 现在会写入文件（此前被静默丢弃），默认路径也不再向 stdout 与文件重复输出。JSON 快照的 reached_spans 现在使用规范的 snake_case 键名与字符串枚举，而非原始整数。
changelog.en: inspect --snapshot no longer collides: --json -o writes the file (was silently dropped) and the default path no longer double-outputs to stdout and file. The JSON snapshot's reached_spans now emit canonical snake_case keys and string enums instead of raw ints.

changelog.zh: 哪怕被攻破的 agent 把调用链改得乱七八糟（断掉或自指的父链接），快照也不会卡死——照样把那一刻的状态给你，而不是一个冻住的终端。
changelog.en: Even when a compromised agent mangles the call chain — broken or self-referencing links — the snapshot won't lock up. You still get the state at that moment, not a frozen terminal.

changelog.zh: 照文档敲的 fork/replay 命令现在能正常解析并指路，不再报未知参数；工具调用不再被误判漏掉，能触达的工具一条都不漏。
changelog.en: Documented fork/replay invocations now parse and point the way instead of erroring on unknown flags; tool spans are no longer misclassified, so every reachable tool stays in the set.

changelog.note: refresh: content re-verified for v0.7.0 (fix-snapshot-payload-base64 — the inspect --json snapshot now emits the readable trigger payload, reinforcing the hero pitch). No content change; CI rebuild.
